sql: select 'pos' k, market_ticker, quantity::text q, realized_pnl::text r, (raw_json ? 'settled_time')::text st, captured_at::text t from positions where market_ticker in ('KXANTHVREQ-28SEP26-T9P5','KXGOOGVREQ-28SEP26-T13') and captured_at > now() - interval '3 hours' union all select 'ord', market_ticker, side||' '||action||' '||limit_price||'x'||quantity, status, coalesce(cancel_reason,''), created_at::text from live_orders where market_ticker in ('KXANTHVREQ-28SEP26-T9P5','KXGOOGVREQ-28SEP26-T13') order by t desc limit 30
